events: When o_c_n mentions being short prey at the Gathering, c_n doesn't hesitate to donate a piece of territory to them.
c_n's leader offers o_c_n a piece of territory that their warriors were having trouble keeping up with. o_c_n accepts.
o_c_n negotiates with c_n at the Gathering and leaves with an additional piece of territory.
o_c_n has started hunting on a piece of c_n's territory. c_n's leader, trying to avoid conflict, has decided to just give o_c_n the land.
Rumour has it that c_n's newest piece of territory, taken from o_c_n, wasn't acquired through any peaceful means.
c_n's leader travels to o_c_n's camp to negotiate for some territory, but leaves empty-pawed.
o_c_n denies c_n's request at the Gathering for hunting rights on their territory.
c_n tries to convince o_c_n to paw over a piece of territory. o_c_n's leader just scoffs.
o_c_n laughs in their face as c_n's leader asks to trade for a piece of territory.

ally:rel_up: It didn't seem possible, but c_n and o_c_n appear even more buddy-buddy these days than ever before.
ally:rel_down: c_n and o_c_n are usually quite friendly, but the other Clans at the Gathering notice that there's a bit of an awkward air between their leaders lately.
amicable:rel_up: c_n and o_c_n are getting even friendlier these days.
amicable:rel_down: c_n and o_c_n's budding friendship seems to have taken a halt. Their leaders can't agree on anything at the Gathering this moon.
neutral:rel_up: c_n and o_c_n's leaders share laughs at the Gathering that no other Clan's leader can hear. Could it be that the two Clans are forming a friendship?
neutral:rel_down: c_n's warriors seem awkward and antsy around o_c_n's warriors at the Gathering.
tense:rel_up: Despite the disagreements the two Clans have been having lately, c_n and o_c_n manage to remain civil at the Gathering.
tense:rel_down: c_n and o_c_n's warriors spread lies about each other to their neighbours at the Gathering.
hostile:rel_up: c_n and o_c_n have been nothing but hostile these days, but, surprisingly, they agree on something at the Gathering.
hostile:rel_down: c_n and o_c_n's leaders almost get into a fight at the Gathering. The relationship between the two Clans has never been rockier.
